reason: A DeepSeek Harness utility that discovers installed third-party bundles and provides a settings panel to enable or disable them by updating the target profile patch configuration.

summaries.zh: 用于在 DeepSeek Harness 设置页发现已安装的第三方插件，并通过修改目标 profile 配置启用或禁用插件。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness utility that lists installed third-party plugins and lets users enable or disable them from the settings panel.

capabilities: Discovers third-party bundles registered in a DeepSeek Harness profile
Displays installed plugin status in a settings panel
Enables or disables registered plugins by updating the profile cordis.patch.yml file
Reads and writes only the target profile patch configuration described in the README
